name: Lit review on sleep and memory

chat_messages.text: I need to write a lit review on sleep and memory consolidation for my cognitive psych class. Can you find me the key papers?

chat_messages.text: Here are foundational and recent papers: Stickgold (2005) on sleep-dependent memory consolidation, Walker & Stickgold (2006), Diekelmann & Born (2010) on the memory function of sleep, and Rasch & Born (2013).
